purpose: Primary-source product and store proposals for newly added top10 destination prefectures. Root integrates these facts into the canonical catalog/visits/translations/content. This research file is not a second public catalog.
method: Read official brand, maker, shop and prefectural pages. The SIMPRICH bubble-earring and Yukie Glass Rouge pages returned cache misses in web tooling, so their live official HTML body was fetched read-only with urllib and parsed. No official photos downloaded or republished.
limits: No affiliate program was applied to or approved. All proposed links are ordinary links with programId:null and no affiliate URL.
Destination ranking is independent of product popularity. Do not call these best-selling products without separate evidence.
Hakata-ori is a recognized traditional craft, but individual accessory certification is not established.
SIMPRICH is a Kofu factory jewelry brand; do not describe these two SKUs as nationally certified Koshu crystal craft or claim the stones were mined in Yamanashi.
Otaru glassmaking is a regional craft context; no national designation is claimed.
CO.COON prices, exact dimensions and current retail stock are not published in the catalog and must remain unknown.

products.nameJa: CO.COON oriノンホールピアス
products.productType: non-pierced earrings (the official catalog calls this an earring, not a pierced stud)
products.appearance: A flared/folded textile motif spreading beside the ear. Exact colors and metal composition are not specified in body text; view the official catalog image before making an illustrative scene.
verifiedFacts: Official gallery identifies oriノンホールピアス, made by hanaroi, as earrings using Hakata-ori.
Brand uses silk threads and fabric dyed and handwoven by Kiyo Araki, collaborating with accessory makers.
products.editorialAngleJa: 金属の輝きより、折りたたまれた布の広がりを楽しむ一組。襟元に直線のある服と組み合わせ、耳元のやわらかな形を引き立てる提案。
whatToCheckJa: 公式ギャラリー掲載品。現在の制作・販売方法、色柄、価格、金具の仕様はブランドで確認。

visitFallback.ja: 常設の購入場所は確認できていません。公式ギャラリーで作品を見て、ブランドの最新の販売案内をご確認ください。
visitFallback.en: A current permanent retail location is not confirmed. View the official gallery and check the brand’s current availability and sales guidance.

products.nameJa: CO.COON フレームシリーズ ピアス
products.appearance: Silk threads are knitted into individual frames. View the exact official catalog image; do not infer metal alloy, geometric dimensions or exact colors from the name.
verifiedFacts: Official gallery identifies フレームシリーズ ピアス, made by hanaroi.
The description explains silk thread being worked by hand into frames.
products.editorialAngleJa: 布が広がるoriとは違い、枠の中に走る糸の線を見せるタイプ。髪を耳にかけた装いで、輪郭と透ける部分の対比を楽しむ提案。
whatToCheckJa: 色柄・寸法・金具素材・現在の価格は公式の販売案内で確認。

visitFallback.ja: 常設店と店頭在庫は未確認です。公式ギャラリーとブランドの販売案内をご確認ください。
visitFallback.en: A permanent shop and current stock are not confirmed. Refer to the official gallery and the brand’s current sales guidance.

products.nameJa: SIMPRICH K18イエローゴールド 水晶しゃぼん玉ピアス
products.nameEn: SIMPRICH K18 yellow-gold crystal bubble earrings
products.taxNote: Tax included, official store; price is for one pair.
products.findings: K18 yellow gold post and catch
products.appearance: Small round bubble-like studs, 7mm. The crystal is bonded to white mother-of-pearl, creating pale pink/green iridescent color. Not plain transparent balls.
verifiedFacts: Official item page lists a pair of crystal and white mother-of-pearl doublet earrings, K18YG post/catch, 7mm each side.
SIMPRICH describes itself as a factory brand of seven Kofu jewelry companies handling planning through production.
The item is made to order; the store lists 1–4 weeks dispatch, not immediate stock.
products.editorialAngleJa: 白蝶貝の淡い干渉色を水晶越しに見る、小さな丸い耳飾り。大ぶりの色石よりも控えめな丸いアクセントを選びたい日に。
whatToCheckJa: 水晶単体ではなく、白蝶貝を貼り合わせた石です。
受注生産。現行の納期は公式商品ページで確認。

products.nameJa: SIMPRICH K10イエローゴールド ローズクォーツ ネックレス
products.appearance: A pale milky pink oval rose quartz within a simple yellow-gold frame, suspended from a fine chain.
verifiedFacts: Official product page lists rose quartz, K10YG, 8×10mm stone and 45cm chain.
Made to order; listed dispatch 1–4 weeks.
products.editorialAngleJa: 透明な輝きよりミルキーな淡いピンクを楽しむペンダント。横長の襟や深すぎないVネックに一点だけ添え、石の丸い輪郭を見せる提案。
whatToCheckJa: 受注生産。石の色味と現在の納期は公式サイトで確認。
原石の採掘国や個別商品の伝統的工芸品認証は確認していません。

products.nameJa: 幸愛硝子 Mint Veil｜若葉の薄衣 1/2
products.nameEn: Yukie Glass Mint Veil earrings, Chronicle-005
products.size: Each approx. 35 × 29mm, 3mm thick; maker lists 8–10g per piece
products.appearance: Large thin, flattened teardrops, translucent soft mint green, with mica. Different from a thick three-dimensional drop.
verifiedFacts: The current official item page identifies flattened crystal-glass/mint-glass/mica earrings and dimensions.
The maker states its glass accessories are made one by one at its Otaru atelier.
Stock is shared with atelier gallery and may change; each handmade piece differs.
products.editorialAngleJa: 縦約3.5cmの大きな雫を、薄いガラスの面として見せる一組。耳元に淡い緑を広く入れたい日に、小粒のスタッドとの違いがはっきりします。
whatToCheckJa: 片方約8〜10gという公式表記です。『軽い』と断定しないでください。
金具素材と現在の作品在庫は公式で確認。
products.visitSupplementJa: アトリエで作品を相談する場合は完全予約制です。北一硝子とは取扱作品が異なり、紹介品の店頭在庫は未確認です。

products.nameJa: 幸愛硝子 Rouge Veil｜紅の薄衣 1/2
products.nameEn: Yukie Glass Rouge Veil earrings, Chronicle-007
products.size: Each approx. 38 × 29mm, 3mm thick; maker lists 8–10g per piece
products.appearance: Large thin flattened clear/deep-red teardrop glass. Do not add mica: that is listed for Mint, not this product.
verifiedFacts: Current official item page lists crystal glass with red colored glass, 38×29mm flattened drops, 3mm thick.
Maker description identifies pierced earrings; specific finding alloy is not published in the reviewed body.
products.editorialAngleJa: ミントより少し縦に長い約3.8cm。黒やチャコールの服に透ける赤を一点入れたいときに、耳元を主役にする提案。
whatToCheckJa: 一点物で在庫をアトリエと共有。現在の販売状況を公式で確認。
片方約8〜10g。金具素材は未確認。
products.visitSupplementJa: アトリエで作品を相談する場合は完全予約制です。北一硝子とは取扱作品が異なり、紹介品の店頭在庫は未確認です。

access.en: About7minutes on foot from the south exit of JR Kofu Station.

stockNote.ja: SIMPRICHの一部商品の取扱い確認です。この2商品の現物・店頭在庫は未確認のため、訪問前に希望品を確認してください。
stockNote.en: Only part of SIMPRICH’s collection is stocked. Neither featured SKU nor current store stock is confirmed; check the exact piece before visiting.
